options.name: allowDuplicate
options.description:
If an external number is given in the settings, this option determines whether a new call will be generated or not.
If this setting is set to V(True), a new call will always be created.
If this setting is set to V(False) (the default), only a new call will be generated if no open call with the same external number is found.

options.name: settings
options.description: The properties for the new call.
